editorial.blurb: A 36-year Italian stalwart with warm service, generous portions, and a lovely dining room that keeps locals and concert-goers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Make reservations well ahead if you're visiting for an amphitheater show nearby—otherwise you'll be eating at 4pm. Take advantage of the free designated parking and have the restaurant validate your ticket upon arrival.

topDishes.note: Bold, flavorful appetizer that sets the tone well
